Title: Process graph DAG invariant hardening
Purpose: Make the process graph legally acyclic, reject self-loops and dependency cycles at save/publish time, and remove the current runtime/canvas fallbacks that silently compensate for invalid cyclic graphs.
Deliverables: A graph-validation path that rejects self-dependencies and multi-step dependency cycles before save/publish succeeds.
Removal of the `StartRunAsync` fallback that seeds the first step when no roots exist.
Removal or fail-fast replacement of the canvas topological-order fallback that appends unresolved nodes silently.
Fresh tests proving invalid cyclic graphs are rejected and valid branching DAGs still run and render correctly.
ReviewQuestions: Can a self-loop or multi-step dependency cycle still be saved or published?
Does runtime startup still contain any silent fallback when the graph has no legal roots?
Does the canvas now fail loudly or diagnose invalid graph order instead of silently appending unresolved nodes?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any cyclic graph can still slip through or any fallback still silently compensates for it, fail the gate and open the graph-invariant corrective playbook.
